description.en: Interactive, tactile, and expressive button components crafted for modern apps.
description.zh: 富有极致触觉反馈、物理回弹与拟物张力的现代交互按钮专门组件库。

content.en: Evil Buttons is a dedicated micro-library celebrating the art of the button. Developed with deep focus on physical depression depths, spring rebounds, magnetic pull, and satisfying click highlights, it ensures the core call-to-action on your website feels irresistible to click.
content.zh: Evil Buttons 是一套专注于将「按钮」这一最核心交互控件做到极致的精品库。深度考究按钮按下的真实物理行程深度、弹性回弹力度、磁吸悬停吸附与按键流光反馈，让每一个行动号召（CTA）都散发着让人忍不住想要按下的操作诱惑力。
